article_content: A mystery woman remains unidentified nearly three months after being hit by a car in Santa Ana, Los Angeles. The woman, referred to as 'Jane Doe,' was struck by a vehicle while walking with a shopping cart at a busy intersection on October 15. She was taken to Western Medical Center in critical condition and has been unable to communicate with staff since her admission. The Santa Ana Police are seeking help in identifying the woman, who may be homeless, as her shopping cart contained many belongings. Her fingerprints did not match any local, state, or federal databases, and she did not match any missing persons reports. The police are urging anyone with information to come forward.
